story.fullStory:
April Wine's "Just Between You And Me" reached #21 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Just Between You and Me" is a single by Canadian hard rock band April Wine, from their ninth studio album The Nature of the Beast, released in 1981 (see 1981 in music).

Background
The music video for this song was the fourteenth video played on MTV's first day of broadcast (August 1, 1981 (1981-08-01)), making it the first video by a Canadian recording artist ever played on MTV.

The final chorus of the album version includes the song's title in French: "Seulement entre toi et moi".

The song peaked at #21 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.
